old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-hahk","title":"C SCHC compress gate skips all UDP validation for ext-header packets and never verifies UDP checksums on the Rule255 fallback path","description":"Confirmed empirically by 3x codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-njdx (three independent reviewers converged; ASan/UBSan-clean C probe). lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc_helpers.c validate_ipv6_transport_lengths:451 tests the OUTER next header (packet[6]) so any HBH(0)/Routing(43)/DSTOPT(60)-led packet returns SCHC_OK before the UDP length check, and no UDP checksum verification exists anywhere on the C compress path (checksum is computed only inside rule compressors over the outer dst, which ext-header packets can never match; schc_compress.c:104/180/406 are compute sites). lichen_schc_compress then emits verbatim Rule255 (subsys/schc/schc.c:122-131) and lichen_link_tx.c:134 transmits. Trigger bytes (src fe80::1, dst fe80::2, RH3 [17,2,3,1,0,0,0,0]+fe80::a, UDP 5000-\u003e5001 'ping'): (1) in-transit RH3 with checksum over the OUTER dst 0xfcef -\u003e Python/Rust REJECT (RFC 2460 s8.1 requires final-dst scope), C ACCEPTS and re-emits ff+packet; (2) UDP length field says 8 with 12 bytes present -\u003e P/R REJECT, C ACCEPTS; (3) wire checksum 0x0000 -\u003e P/R REJECT, C ACCEPTS; (4) HBH-terminated UDP with garbage checksum 0xdead -\u003e P/R REJECT, C ACCEPTS. Same root cause makes the njdx in-transit checksum-scope vector vacuous under C. Related pre-existing instance of the identical gap (same bead fix): plain UDP to non-5683/non-10883 ports with wrong (0x1234) or zero checksum is accepted by the C Rule255 fallback while Python/Rust reject (rules only verify checksums for CoAP/MQTT-SN/ICMPv6 shapes). Impact: C nodes inject Rule255 datagrams every Rust/Python node fatals on at ingress decode_rule255 -\u003e validate_full_ipv6 (blackhole/partition on mixed fleets). Fix: track the chain-final offset and upper-layer destination in the C walk (mirroring Rust codec.rs:281-348), verify UDP length + nonzero valid checksum over the RFC 2460 s8.1 destination there, and apply the same checks to the direct-UDP fallback path; add shared malformed vectors for each class.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-08-30T18:18:45.528802Z","created_by":"opencode-worker-5","updated_at":"2026-08-30T18:18:45.528802Z","dependencies":[{"issue_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-hahk","depends_on_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-njdx","type":"discovered-from","created_at":"2026-08-30T18:18:45.793998Z","created_by":"opencode-worker-5","metadata":"{}"}]}

new_value: Re-close: this close was lost in a beads-store merge (live store resurrected pre-close in_progress state with no close reason; the work itself was already complete and committed before the close). Fixed and pinned. C compress gate validates ALL version-6 packets (including the Rule255 fallback) via validate_ipv6_transport_lengths -> validate_ipv6_header_chain (schc_helpers.c): ext-header chain walk tracking final offset + RFC 2460 s8.1 upper_destination (final RH3 address while segments_left != 0, else outer dst), UDP length == remaining, wire checksum nonzero, checksum valid over upper_destination. Gate at lichen_schc_compress (schc.c:557) runs before rule matching so both rule-compressed and fallback emissions are covered. Shared malformed vectors pinned in test/vectors/schc_compression.json: srh3_outer_dst_checksum_malformed, ext_header_udp_length_mismatch_malformed, hbh_udp_bad_checksum_malformed, udp_zero_checksum_malformed (+ routing_type0, srh3_segments_left_overflow, ipv6_fragment from njdx). Verification (heft, ASan/UBSan): python parity subset 714 passed; rust shared_vectors 3 passed (48-vector corpus; oscore path redirected to /home/mark/crates/oscore in a throwaway worktree, not committed); C schc_parity_test 48 vectors PASS (clang 20, -Werror, -std=c23, sanitizers); C host lichen/tests/schc PASS. Codereview 3x per step 4 with reviewer model: correctness kimi-k3 (fix arithmetic bit-exact vs Python headers.py + Rust codec.rs; 2 adjacent pre-existing findings), edge-cases kimi-k3 (all listed edges consistent across 3 impls; 2 pre-existing findings + 1 out-of-scope note), security: claude-opus-4-5 failed twice with opencode server errors (err_c54443ff, err_540578e3) so kimi-k3 fallback ran (no bypass/DoS/OOB/out-buffer-write; corroborated the one substantive gap) PLUS a deeper probe-driven pass by worker5 subagent (29 attacker packets through the real gate under ASan+UBSan vs Python RX, independent RFC 1071 oracle). No pass found any defect in the committed fix itself. Findings filed as beads discovered-from this one: wrxl P1 (C gate lacks IPv6 address policy), 7v5f P2 (non-IPv6 Rule255 passthrough), 1npp P2 (22554 encoded-ceiling off-by-one), 5b1y P2 (rust decompress 0xFFFF mapping), 89z7 P3 (RH3 reserved octets + HEL laxity shared by all 3 impls), uylk P3 (validator version self-check), yvu8 P3 (l2 crash_info mislabel), lsrv P3 (link_schc.h doc), 5o7x P3 (gen_vectors expect_error presence), upyr P1 + silq P1 (both since closed - fixed by ef4eb8de22). nyx7's requested pkt_len guard IS present (schc_helpers.c:465-467); its direct-call unit test remains for nyx7's owner.
